question: Can you give me a FASTA sequence of the human genome region chr1:100000-200000 using the GRCh38 (hg38) human genome reference?

files.eval_guideline: The sequence must match the reference; case and line-wrap may differ.
files.match_reasoning: Same filename (chr1_region.fasta), both are FASTA files of the extracted chr1:100000-200000 region.
files.strategy_reasoning: Pulling a region out of the reference genome is deterministic, and the guideline says the sequence must match, with only case and line wrapping allowed to differ. Exact comparison ignoring case handles that, since line breaks are normalized when the file is loaded. Matching is by content because the header naming isn't fixed.
